_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commitments" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_json" TEXT NULL, "total_target" INTEGER NULL, "daily_commitment" INTEGER NULL, "due_day" TEXT NULL, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "remind_at" TEXT NULL, "deadline" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "archive_note" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitments (uuid), "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seed_notes" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitments (uuid), "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "folder" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_links" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (uuid), "to_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_uuid" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_json" TEXT NULL, "remind_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memories" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "album_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES albums (uuid), "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'photo', "note" TEXT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_days" ("harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_counter" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("harvest_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" INTEGER NOT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "body_part" TEXT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "target" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programs" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "weeks" INTEGER NULL, "commitment_uuid" TEXT NULL, "album_uuid" TEXT NULL, "photo_prompt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'after', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_days" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (uuid), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "week" INTEGER NULL, "accessories" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_slots" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES program_days (uuid), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bar_grams" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20000, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target_sets" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES program_slots (uuid), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "weight_grams" INTEGER NULL, "percent_tenths" INTEGER NULL, "open_ended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("open_ended" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_maxes" ("program_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (uuid), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("program_uuid", "exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_uuid" TEXT NULL, "day_uuid" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (uuid), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "slot_uuid" TEXT NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bar_grams" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20000, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_exercise_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (uuid), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_grams" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "target_label" TEXT NULL, "open_ended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("open_ended" IN (0, 1)), "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streaks" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "best" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_earned_day" TEXT NULL, "freezes_stored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("scope"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quests" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "claimed_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pomodoro_sessions" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_uuid" TEXT NULL, "focus_blocks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DZD', "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_txns" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "account" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DZD', "note" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "reference" TEXT NULL, "link_uuid" TEXT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debts" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DZD', "pay_off_by" TEXT NULL, "remind_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "settled_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debt_payments" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "debt_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES debts (uuid), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "harvest_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
